name: Object Marker (diagonal stripes)
spec: vertical rectangle with alternating black and yellow diagonal stripes sloping down to the right
meaning: Marks an obstruction next to the road; keep to the side the stripes slope toward.

snippets.back: Object markers warn of something in the road or right at its edge, a reminder not to drift out of your lane.
Traffic Island and Object Marker indications identify a roadway division or nearby obstruction.
Object markers flag things just off the road edge, such as bridge ends and underpass supports.

result.summary: Snippets support obstruction meaning but never describe shape, color, or stripe direction.
